rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: Kantei's account 第二次小泉内閣の発足, dated 19 November 2003, states that the 158th special session convened that day re-designated 小泉純一郎総理 by agreeing votes of both Houses, and that after forming the second cabinet 小泉総理 was appointed at the Imperial appointment ceremony as the 88th Prime Minister (56th person), followed by the ministers' attestation.

locator.section: paragraphs 1 and 3 under 平成１５年１１月１９日

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The same page records the launch of the second Koizumi cabinet (第二次小泉内閣) on 19 November 2003, all ministers of the September reshuffle being reappointed, and the first cabinet meeting that night.
